none: PAS NLM-623C47: Roman Denarius Copy of Septimius Severus
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ SEVERVS PIVS AVG ; R/ LIBERTAS AVGVSTI

Silver, now shiny dark brown – the finder notes other artefacts from this field have same surface appearance. Denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211), but not encountered under this reign in RIC. Obverse description: Severus head laureate right. Obverse inscription: SEVERVS PIVS AVG Reverse description: Libertas, seated left, holding pileus and sceptre. Reverse inscription: LIBERTAS AVGVSTI Very good and clear condition; a crack in flan noted by finder following microscopic examination. Sam Moorhead kindly comments: ‘Odd coin. Looks like a contemporary copy. The overall style of the coin is slightly crude’ Diameter: 17.88mm, Weight: 2.24gms. Die axis: 6
